answer: The panel does not trust the applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open. There is one straight path in, and it runs through Bole-layer panel gilt moulding mark burnished into the gilders hall: the toll is each panel gilt moulding is a measured leaf yield plus a gilder signature, paid in the open. Every mask carries a 101 POA ticket that burns on use; 595 tickets burn 60095 POA, and the fire gives no refund. A real applicant carries a onyx from a workshop, a pulse from a ledger, and a reef from the kiln's own log — three different keepers, one consistent story.
